content: Prisma migrate deploy applies pending migrations with no shadow database and does not detect drift (production schema silently diverging from migration history, e.g. from a manual hotfix SQL change or someone running db push against prod). Shadow DB is a dev-only safety net used by migrate dev to catch drift/data-loss before generating a migration; it is not involved in migrate deploy. Dev-side drift also happens if db push is used during prototyping then the team switches to migrate dev without reconciling. Seeding: prisma migrate reset triggers the configured seed script automatically; migrate deploy does not seed.
